youtube.baslik: Why is the patient asked to count during rotary chair testing? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In rotary chair testing, the person sits in darkness and eye movements are recorded with video goggles. To keep the vestibulo-ocular reflex from fading in darkness, the person stays alert with mental tasks such as counting. Gain is the ratio of slow phase eye velocity to chair velocity; a drowsy patient can give falsely low gain, so keep up mental tasks at every frequency.
